main.description: Return a kubeconfig for the named cluster of the calling account. Creates on read: if the account has no cluster of this name, this call creates the account workspace, its home, the Cluster record (spec.running=false) and the mounted child, then returns a kubeconfig. Idempotent - a second call finds everything and returns the same thing. Requires a service-auth JWT from the CALLER's own PDS; the account is the VERIFIED token's iss and is never read from this input. A cluster whose spec.running is false answers ClusterNotRunning; call createCluster or controlPlaneUp first. This call does not wake the control plane. The kubeconfig carries a client key and a short-lived x509 client certificate issued by the cluster's own OpenBao PKI. The key is made by OpenBao and returned only in this response; nothing stores it. ttlSeconds sets the certificate lifetime.

name.description: The cluster label, unique within the calling account. RFC-1123 label, <=63 characters.

ttlSeconds.description: Lifetime of the client certificate in seconds. Absent is 28800 (8 h). Below 60 or above 86400 is InvalidRequest: refused, never clamped. Never together with noExpiry.

noExpiry.description: Issue a certificate with no expiry (NotAfter 9999-12-31T23:59:59Z truncated to the cluster CA). It ends only by revocation (revokeIdentity), deleteCluster, or the CA expiring. Never together with ttlSeconds.

kubeconfig.description: The whole kubeconfig, as YAML text. users[0].user holds client-certificate-data and client-key-data; there is no exec block and no token. The certificate's CN is the caller DID and its O is socialweb.computer:cluster-owners. Keep the file mode 0600; never commit it.

instance.description: status.instance: the opaque per-materialisation generation id of the cluster this kubeconfig points at. Retain it - a cached kubeconfig whose instance no longer matches must not be reused, and a new instance exists after every delete-then-recreate; controlPlaneDown and controlPlaneUp and a gateway restart keep the instance, because the cluster keeps its CA and state.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: Name absent, or not a legal RFC-1123 label within 63 characters.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.description: Missing or invalid service-auth token. Also returned when the token's aud is not this service or its lxm is not this method.

errors.name: IdentityRevoked
errors.description: The caller's identity carries a deny record for this account. The deny is written before any deletion, so it refuses while the revocation is still propagating.

errors.name: ClusterNotFound
errors.description: This account has no cluster of that name. Deliberately indistinguishable from a name that belongs to another account.

errors.name: ClusterNotRunning
errors.description: The cluster exists but spec.running is false. Call createCluster or controlPlaneUp, then call this again.

errors.name: ClusterInitializing
errors.description: The control plane or its vault is coming up. Retry after the Retry-After header.
